The top sign displays stylized, illegible text resembling 'Cafe' or similar, with a blueish glow. The bottom sign is split into two sections: the left contains abstract geometric shapes and pseudo-text in blue neon style, while the right features a glowing white silhouette of a figure (possibly a person or animal) that appears distorted. The signs have a futuristic, cyberpunk aesthetic with neon-like edges. There is faint graffiti or text in the bottom right corner.
